sourceEvidence.heading: 1.2 Mara's morning
sourceEvidence.quote: Her personal agent compares the contract with thousands of others, estimates the future value of the data, and proposes three responses.

sourceEvidence.heading: 1.2 Mara's morning
sourceEvidence.quote: We call “hostage mutualism” a relationship that produces real benefits for both sides, but in which one side gradually accumulates control over memory, interface, identity, or the cost of exit.

sourceEvidence.heading: 3.1 The rabbits, the virus, and the error of the comforting story
sourceEvidence.quote: Rabbits evolved resistance, while some viral variants of intermediate virulence transmitted better than those that killed too quickly.

sourceEvidence.heading: 3.1 The rabbits, the virus, and the error of the comforting story
sourceEvidence.quote: Virulence can rise again when transmission is efficient enough, when vectors continue to carry the virus from sick hosts, or when competition among strains favors rapid replication.

sourceEvidence.heading: 3.1 The rabbits, the virus, and the error of the comforting story
sourceEvidence.quote: If the source is easily replaced, if damage appears late, or if the extractor can shift the cost onto third parties, the pressure toward moderation weakens.

sourceEvidence.heading: 10.3 The ecology of freedom
sourceEvidence.quote: Data portability is not enough if memory, reputation, and agent functions cannot be transferred.

sourceEvidence.heading: 10.3 The ecology of freedom
sourceEvidence.quote: The agent that recommends should not automatically have the right to act.

sourceEvidence.heading: 10.3 The ecology of freedom
sourceEvidence.quote: The central actor learns from the population; the individual must not be left to learn only from personal harm.

sourceEvidence.heading: 10.3 The ecology of freedom
sourceEvidence.quote: Organizations must measure not only present production, but also renewal of competence.

sourceEvidence.heading: NORMATIVE THESIS
sourceEvidence.quote: A social relationship is less predatory to the extent that one party’s benefit depends on preserving the other party’s capacity to understand, refuse, learn, and change partners.

scenes.title: Hostage mutualism
lines: Ecology of Predation asks how useful cooperation can gradually become captivity.
Its imagined AI society begins with real benefits, rather than obvious villains.
A lawyer negotiates better while her provider gains control over her accumulated capabilities.
The book calls this hostage mutualism: cooperation that one partner can turn into captivity.
It asks which practical freedoms must survive as useful relationships become indispensable.

art.composition: A lived-in lawyer’s home bureau, not floating interface cards: a physical work desk, a disputed contract, a calendar and a service-owned working archive integrated into the room. The character is an illustration of Mara’s fictional 2038 scenario, not a claim about a deployed product.
actionByLine: Begin on the lawyer assessing a difficult contract at the desk; a second annotated version enters her working area.
She compares the proposed terms and visibly finds useful leverage; posture opens and she has a meaningful choice.
The correspondence she produces accumulates in the provider-controlled archive while the contract remains on her desk.
Pull back to reveal that access to accumulated working capability passes through that archive; a changed service term reaches her. No unexplained gate or floating padlock.
She can still use the helpful service, but a move toward an alternative work area leaves part of the working archive behind. Hold on her recognition of the asymmetry.
art.emotion: Relief at real help → confidence → unease as the same benefit creates dependence.
art.sourceFidelity: Use no invented numerical performance gain or real brand; this is the book’s explicitly imagined household/professional situation.

scenes.title: Dependence is no guarantee
scenes.lens: content sample explaining the book’s biological comparison
lines: One chapter follows rabbits and the myxoma virus introduced in Australia.
Rabbits evolved resistance, while some less lethal viral variants initially spread more effectively.
Later developments challenged the comforting story that dependence inevitably produces gentler relationships.
Changing defenses and transmission conditions can favor more damaging variants again.
The book asks when institutions likewise benefit by passing their damage onto others.

art.composition: Close field-study view of a rabbit habitat, followed through time; expressive rabbits, feeding vegetation and a visibly changing transmission route. The scene replaces the earlier potted-plant diagram with the actual source example.
actionByLine: Establish a small habitat and a clearly identified historical episode. Avoid invented population statistics.
Show a resistant rabbit continuing to feed while an initially damaging interaction becomes less successful; an alternative viral route remains transmissible.
Advance the same habitat through time, preserving the rabbit and transmission relationship rather than swapping in unrelated icons.

Make a changed transmission route reach another host even when the first is less able to move; label the changed condition once. Treat this as a schematic ecological relation, not a microscopic simulation.
Transition back to the lawyer’s world through the same cost-transfer relation: the institution retains a benefit while the burden reaches someone beyond its reporting area. No graphic animal injury.
art.emotion: Attention and discovery → interruption of an overly comforting expectation → practical concern.
art.sourceFidelity: Avoid anthropomorphic intent or a universal evolutionary law. The source reports later renewed virulence under changed transmission/defense conditions; no claim that nature morally validates institutional behavior.

scenes.title: Files are not functioning alternatives
lines: In its agent scenario, downloading your files does not necessarily restore your independence.
Your new provider may lack the learned functions that made those records useful.
The original service still holds your working memory, reputation, or powers to act.
Leaving can therefore mean rebuilding capabilities while everyday obligations continue arriving.
The distinction is between owning information and retaining usable alternatives.

art.composition: Return to the same recognizable lawyer and ongoing negotiation; the scene is one continuous attempted move between working environments, not Provider A/Provider B icons plus a Memory capsule.
actionByLine: She takes the documents from the original desk to an alternative station; the documents genuinely arrive.
A pending negotiation needs the learned context and delegated capability that made the previous work useful; the replacement station cannot complete the same next step.
Reveal which functional links remain tied to the original working archive, with short object-level labels only where necessary.
New correspondence and a calendar deadline arrive while she reconstructs the missing context; show real time and labor, no fake quantified loss.
Hold the complete files beside the still unfinished reply, making possession versus ability to act visually unmistakable.
art.emotion: Initial optimism about leaving → interruption → effort and clarity.
art.sourceFidelity: An authored illustration of the book’s conditional portability hypothesis; do not imply every agent/provider today behaves this way or that every permission should transfer without review.

scenes.title: Freedom needs working alternatives
scenes.lens: book journey and earned reader invitation
lines: The book expands this question through work, markets, education, intimacy, and public institutions.
It also examines who learns faster when platforms observe millions of interactions.
Its comparisons are hypotheses to test; nature does not grant anyone moral permission.
The constructive chapters propose portable capabilities, separate permissions, and protected routes for apprenticeship.
Begin with Mara’s morning, then follow the mechanisms that make her benefits complicated.
Read it to judge whether another party’s success preserves your ability to refuse and learn.

art.composition: A wider inhabited view connecting the original lawyer’s work, a supervised learning setting and a public review process, followed by a close return to the lawyer’s choice. These are working environments, not a row of field icons. Optional actual book cover can sit on the reading desk; no generic book drawing.
actionByLine: Pull back from the lawyer’s desk to reveal that her daily scenario already intersects several institutions; select two visible environments rather than showing a five-item list.
Contrast one person’s single case with an institution’s many retained observations, then let collective review make one shared finding available to that person.
Pause movement on the actual comparison; maintain attribution rather than introducing a caution badge or new abstract symbol.
Show a proposed alternative preserving a usable working context while the person separately reviews what the agent may do; keep a learner actively reconstructing a decision with a mentor.
Return to the source scenario’s morning and its unresolved contract, making the suggested reading route concrete.
End with the person retaining a real choice between capable alternatives; the original useful relationship remains available, without a triumphal promise that every conflict is solved.
art.emotion: Wider recognition → constructive possibility → thoughtful invitation.
art.sourceFidelity: Explicitly a proposal, not deployed functionality. The final scene preserves learning/refusal and does not present total independence from other people or institutions as the goal.
